newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek construction firms agree to buy Cambas Wines.
newsitem.headline: Greek construction firms agree to buy Cambas Wines.

text.p: Greece's Boutaris Holding SA signed an accord for the transfer of a 67 percent stake in Cambas Wines to a group of construction firms, said National Bank of Greece.
Cambas Wines is a subsidiary of Boutaris Holding SA and has been suspended from trading on the Athens bourse.

The agreement calls for the restructuring and retirement of bank debt accumulated by Cambas Wines and the transfer of a majority 67 percent stake to Mesogaia SA, a consortium of construction companies, it said in a statement.
Aktor, Hellenic Technodomiki, ERGAS, Meton and Technical Company of Volos make up the Mesogaia consortium, it added.
The agreement will be sumbitted for ratification to the Athens Appeals Court, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
